task_summary: Customer reports that the Framed Wall Mirror from order ORD-6023 arrived damaged due to shipping. The correct resolution is to process a refund to the original payment method and provide a return label, following the shipping damage policy. If the item is classified as fragile, an additional goodwill credit should be applied.

Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
